output.question: How many employees does Capital One have?
output.answer: Capital One Financial Corporation had about 77,500 employees as of September 30, 2026, the end of Q3 2026. That figure comes from the financial supplement attached to its Q3 2026 earnings release of October 20, 2026. Headcount was about 78,400 at the end of Q2 2026, 77,100 at the end of Q1 2026 and 76,300 at the end of 2025. The roughly 45% jump from about 52,600 at the end of 2024 reflects the Discover acquisition, which closed on May 18, 2025.

key_facts.fact: Period-end employees were 77.5 thousand (about 77,500) in Q3 2026.
Period-end employees were 78.4 thousand in Q2 2026, 77.1 thousand in Q1 2026, 76.3 thousand in Q4 2025 and 77.0 thousand in Q3 2025.
The Q3 2026 earnings release is dated October 20, 2026.

caveats: The figures are reported in thousands and rounded to one decimal, so 77,500 is approximate.
Headcount fell slightly from Q2 2026 (78.4 thousand) to Q3 2026 (77.5 thousand). Numbers change every quarter.
The year-end 2024 baseline (about 52,600) and the May 18, 2025 closing date of the Discover deal come only from search-result summaries of secondary sources. I did not read them on a primary page.
This is the consolidated count for Capital One Financial Corp., Discover included. It is not the count for any single subsidiary.
